newsitem.title: UK: Polar Air restarts flights to Prestwick on Aug 7.
newsitem.headline: Polar Air restarts flights to Prestwick on Aug 7.

text.p: Polar Air Cargo is to re-start its service to Prestwick airport on August 7 to meet increasing U.S. shipper demand for direct services to Scotland, Polar Air executive vice president, Jack Kane said.

Polar will operate three weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter services from New York to Prestwick providing capacity for shippers in the U.S. including those in the Midwest, Southeast and Northeast, the company said in a statement.
"A number of Polar's customers, primarily air freight forwarders handling high-tech goods, have requested main deck capacity from the U.S. direct to Prestwick" Kane added.
The all-cargo airline began a service to the UK in 1993 with one frequency through Prestwick and this was transferred in 1996 to London-Heathrow.

Within one year, this service was increased to three weekly flights as Polar began building upon the traffic rights it was awarded by the U.S. Department of Transportation under the U.S-UK air services agreement,the statement added.
Earlier in 1997, Polar launched a twice weekly service to Manchester making a total of five flights per week to the U.K.

Beyond services are offered to Amsterdam and New Delhi, with dedicated trucking available to numerous points in the U.K and on the Continent.it said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
